ph.alt: Carroll and Bessie E. Jones House

wx: The Carroll and Bessie E. Jones House, also known as Poke's Cottage or The Stone House, is a private house located at 170 West Main Street in Marcellus, Michigan. It was designated a Michigan State Historic Site in 1986 and listed on the National Register of Historic Places in 1997.
